title: Keep waiting for verify while its prerequisite jobs run
body: Observed on PR #353: gh pr checks --required reports no required checks with exit code 1 more than eight minutes after CI starts. The required verify job depends on the prerequisite, test-shard and crawl jobs, so it is only registered after those jobs finish. scripts/ship.ts abandons this normal state after a separate five-minute startup grace, despite its one-hour CI wait deadline. Treat an absent required check as pending throughout the existing deadline, retain immediate failure for real CLI/check errors, and add clock-controlled tests for delayed registration, failure and timeout.
